quarterly_data.quarter: Dell press release: Meet the Dell 14S: An Affordable Laptop Built for Students, (09-02-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: At IFA 2026 Dell announced the Dell 14S, a lightweight everyday Windows laptop for students and young adults, complementing the XPS 13: Intel Core 5 and Core 7 Series 3 processors, a 13.5mm thin, 1.15kg aluminum chassis in four colors, a 750ED PNCM battery for up to 21 hours of Netflix streaming on a single charge, 2.8K 120Hz or 2K 60Hz 16:10 display options and Wi-Fi 6E. It will be available in North America this fall; pricing will be disclosed closer to availability in each market.
quarterly_data.figure: up to 21 hours streaming; 13.5mm, 1.15kg; North America availability this fall; price not disclosed
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: supplier (Intel Core 5 and Core 7 Series 3 processors)
